checks.name: empty native store is distinguished from a read failure
synchronous write is committed before returning
new runtime instance retains Unicode and all profile fields
an existing profile key is preserved without renaming
read failures return an explicit failure instead of empty profile
write failure is reported and leaves existing profile intact
GLES context flags query returns no native flags without invoking invalid WebGL enum
invalid context-flags output pointer records the real GL error
all other GL integer queries retain the original implementation
3D texture upload uses the standard ten-argument source-view overload
all 16 dither depth slices reference the exact original WASM pixels
float texture upload converts byte pointers into the correct typed-array offset
pixel-unpack buffer preserves numeric offsets, including zero
out-of-range input is forwarded for real GL validation, never padded or masked

method: Execute the actual .jslib source in isolated JavaScript runtimes. Shared storage simulates reload. WebGL driver calls are recorded, not real GPU validation.
